title: Flaw or Artifact? Rethinking Prompt Sensitivity in Evaluating LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology of evaluating LLMs, specifically examining prompt sensitivity and comparing heuristic evaluation methods with LLM-as-a-judge. It evaluates models on science, math, and factual benchmarks (ARC, GPQA, OpenbookQA, NarrativeQA, MATH, SimpleQA) and does not address religion, morals, or ethics.
